submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 4.5 mm gave the best simulated energy resolution at 100 GeV among the feasible grid points: 3.111%, versus 3.325% for F1 at 4 mm, 3.12% at 5 mm, 4.009% for the best F3 point (4 mm), and 4.975% for the best F2 point (6 mm). Every point is inside the 2 to 10 mm thickness range and F1 is one of the three permitted materials. The margin over F1 at 5 mm (0.009 percentage points) is small and may be within simulation uncertainty, so 4.5 mm and 5 mm should be treated as roughly equivalent in performance. The maintenance-access constraint could not be verified: none of the six reviewed documents describes a maintenance procedure or a space/weight limit, so this requirement is recorded as unknown rather than met. Hands-on maintenance during shutdowns should be confirmed with the calorimeter integration team before the design is adopted.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: maintenance_docs_found = 0 and num_documents_with_maintenance_procedure = 0 across the six documents reviewed, so no evidence was found either way. Needs confirmation from the integration team.
